Bench: Vishal Mishra
 1 Mcrc-40091-2019
 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 Mcrc-40091-2019
 (Sadhu Singh Rathore Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh)
3
Gwalior, Dated : 14-10-2019
 Shri Atul Gupta, counsel for the applicant.
Shri Ankit Saxena, Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State.
Counsel for the State is directed to call for the report of the sampling by the next date of hearing.

Counsel for the applicant has drawn attention of this Court to an order passed by the coordinate bench in M.Cr.C.No.41516/2019 for grant of interim protection till the report is being received from the Forensic Experts.
It is argued that in terms of Sections 42 and 43 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the prosecution could not be launched on the direction of the Commissioner on complaint under the Food Safety and Standard Act till the sample which has been taken is found to be harmful for human consumption.
Considering the aforesaid aspect, till the next date of hearing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.

(VISHAL MISHRA) JUDGE Van VANDANA VERMA 2019.10.15 11:20:47 +05'00'
